title: An interest-payment waiver on a not-charged-off loan credits LOAN_PORTFOLIO and merges the interest+fee receivables into ONE credit (loan 2 L4: credits 10.00 then 30.00, debit 40.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an INTEREST_PAYMENT_WAIVER posted on loan 2 (product LP1_INTEREST_FLAT, NOT charged off) on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). request.interest_payment_waiver_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back transaction id 4 (externalId L4): principalPortion 10.0 -> "1000", interestPortion 10.0 -> "1000", feeChargesPortion 20.0 -> "2000", penaltyChargesPortion 0 and overpaymentPortion 0. The charged-off state is the read-back's top-level chargedOff false. accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping from the accepted create request create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json (sha256 af7c2cde...f13d): loanPortfolio 2, receivable interest/fee/penalty 4, overpayment 17, interestOnLoan 9, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 20. expect.interest_payment_waiver_journal_legs transcribes the three L4 legs in id order from the sweep: JE 8 CREDIT account 2 10.0, JE 9 CREDIT account 4 30.0 (the interest and fee portions MERGED because both slots map to account 4), JE 10 DEBIT account 9 40.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES: the not-charged-off credit slots and the merge of same-account credits. It does NOT grade the charged-off branch. Nothing was computed: every portion, account and leg is read directly from the committed files; amounts are exact decimals parsed to integer minor units, never a float.
